name: Hermes Agent mixed-surface localization pressure test
description: Mixed-surface Web/Desktop/CLI localization pressure test: YAML catalogs, TypeScript web/desktop catalogs, and Docusaurus documentation, pinned to a single upstream commit.

yaml_cli_gateway.notes: Nested YAML catalogs flattened to dotted keys at runtime by agent/i18n.py; str.format {placeholders}; official French catalog is partial.

web_dashboard.notes: Typed nested object catalogs (string leaves and weekday tuples); partial override catalogs via defineLocale; official French catalog is partial.

desktop.notes: Largest surface: 318 function-valued messages with template literals and ${expressions}; no official French catalog exists; enablement requires types.ts/catalog.ts/languages.ts registration.

documentation.notes: Docusaurus site with en + zh-Hans locales; inventoried for coverage analysis only in the engineering run.

controlled.description: English source is canonical; official French resources are hidden during generation and revealed only afterward as comparison references.

agent_system.description: Reviewed French resources from one Hermes surface supply glossary/style evidence to another surface while English remains source truth; tm_assisted not exercised in the engineering run.

generation.description: No provider credentials were available in the approved environment; the run uses a conservative local draft (identity copy plus a small curated French slice) to prove extraction, staging, QA, and build plumbing. A provider-agnostic import flow is provided for real generation.
